ei.title: Does Local Food Really Cut Carbon Emissions?
ei.subject: 9월_2023 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: Does Local Food Really Cut Carbon Emissions?

fullPassage: Claims that local food production cut greenhouse gas emissions by reducing the burning of transportation fuel are usually not well founded. Transport is the source of only 11 percent of greenhouse gas emissions within the food sector, so reducing the distance that food travels after it leaves the farm is far less important than reducing wasteful energy use on the farm. Food coming from a distance can actually be better for the climate, depending on how it was grown. For example, field-grown tomatoes shipped from Mexico in the winter months will have a smaller carbon footprint than local winter tomatoes grown in a greenhouse. In the United Kingdom, lamb meat that travels 11,000 miles from New Zealand generates only one-quarter the carbon emissions per pound compared to British lamb because farmers in the United Kingdom raise their animals on feed (which must be produced using fossil fuels) rather than on clover pastureland. When food does travel, what matters most is not the distance traveled but the travel mode (surface versus air), and most of all the load size. Bulk loads of food can travel halfway around the world by ocean freight with a smaller carbon footprint, per pound delivered, than foods traveling just a short distance but in much smaller loads. For example, 18-wheelers carry much larger loads than pickup trucks so they can move food 100 times as far while burning only one-third as much gas per pound of food delivered.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① is → are: 주어 Claims(복수)라서 복수 동사 are
det.analysis:
❌ ① is → are — 문장의 주어는 'Claims that ... fuel(~라는 주장들)'로 복수예요. 그래서 단수 is가 아니라 복수 are를 써야 해요. 'Claims ... are usually not well founded' ←정답

✅ ② coming — 'Food coming from a distance(멀리서 오는 식품)'에서 명사 Food를 꾸미는 현재분사라 맞아요

✅ ③ shipped — 'tomatoes shipped from Mexico(멕시코에서 실려 온 토마토)'는 토마토가 '실려 온' 것이라 과거분사가 맞아요

✅ ④ traveling — 'foods traveling just a short distance(짧은 거리를 이동하는 식품)'는 명사 foods를 꾸미는 현재분사라 맞아요

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② growing → grown: 'was + 과거분사'인 수동태라 grown
det.analysis:
✅ ① reducing — 전치사 by 뒤라 동명사 reducing이 맞아요. 'by reducing the burning(연소를 줄임으로써)'

❌ ② growing → grown — 'depending on how it was ______'에서 식품(it)은 '재배되는' 대상이에요. 'was + 과거분사'인 수동태라 grown을 써야 해요. growing(현재분사)은 능동이라 틀려요 ←정답

✅ ③ produced — 'must be produced(생산되어야 한다)'는 'be + 과거분사' 수동태라 맞아요

✅ ④ traveling — 'foods traveling(이동하는 식품)'은 명사를 꾸미는 현재분사라 맞아요
det.tip: be동사(was) + 과거분사 = 수동태 → grown.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

✅ ② smaller — 'a smaller carbon footprint(더 작은 탄소 발자국)'라는 맥락에 맞아요

✅ ③ generates — 'generates ... carbon emissions(배출을 발생시킨다)'라는 맥락에 맞아요

✅ ④ larger — '18-wheelers carry much larger loads(더 큰 짐을 나른다)'라는 맥락에 맞아요
det.tip: 글은 멀리서 온 식품이 '더 나을' 수 있다고 주장 → better.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② more(더) → less(덜): 이동 거리를 줄이는 것이 '덜' 중요하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① reducing — 'by reducing the burning(연소를 줄임으로써)'이라는 맥락에 맞아요

❌ ② more → less — 'reducing the distance ... is far ______ important than reducing wasteful energy use'에서, 글쓴이는 거리를 줄이는 것이 농장 에너지 낭비를 줄이는 것보다 '훨씬 덜(less)' 중요하다고 해요. more(더)는 논지와 반대예요 ←정답

✅ ③ climate — 'better for the climate(기후에 더 이로운)'라는 맥락에 맞아요

✅ ④ raise — 'raise their animals(가축을 기른다)'라는 맥락에 맞아요
det.tip: 글의 핵심: 거리 줄이기는 '덜' 중요 → less.

det.korean: F(불일치): 운송은 식품 부문 배출의 11퍼센트에 불과하다

det.tip: only 11 percent → 절반이 넘는다는 것은 틀림(F).

det.analysis:
